summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Columbia International Equity Income ETF (INEQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of dividend-paying companies in developed markets outside the US. The fund uses a proprietary, fundamental selection process with an exclusionary screen for ESG risk INEQ was launched on Jun 13, 2016 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.

holdings.infoBox: INEQ is an equity ETF with a total of 103 individual holdings. The top holdings are UniCredit stock at 4.59%, BHP Group at 4.41%, Mitsubishi at 4.27%, Deutsche Telekom AG at 4.22%, and Siemens Energy Ag Common Stock at 4.21%.
